::: {#def-sampling-distribution}
#### Sampling distribution

The **sampling distribution**
[@wikipedia_sampling_distribution] of an [estimator](#def-estimator) $\hparam$
is the probability distribution of $\hparam(\dsn{X})$
over repeated random samples $\dsn{X}$ from the same population:
the distribution of the values the estimator would take
across all the samples we might have drawn.
:::
